description: Official host whitelist for the tutorial sources ledger. Every external link in a lesson body and every url in sources/<course>.json must use https and match one entry here. An entry matches a url whose hostname equals `host` exactly and, when `pathPrefixes` is present, whose path starts with one of them. Each entry names the tool whose official site it is. Adding a host means adding it here with its tool, and the host must be the tool's own site, not a mirror or a third-party guide.

entries.note: GitHub official site. Repositories under other organisations are not checked by this file; use a tool-specific entry below when a tool's own repository is the source.
GitHub official documentation, including GitHub Actions and GitHub Pages
GitHub Desktop official download and product page
Alibaba Cloud official help center, including ESA documentation
MDN Web Docs, maintained by Mozilla; the reference for HTML, CSS and JavaScript
Anthropic official documentation, including model and pricing pages
OpenAI API platform: model list, API keys and pricing
Pi coding agent official site and documentation
Pi source repository, published by its maintainers
Tencent Cloud international documentation for CodeBuddy Code
Tencent Cloud documentation for CodeBuddy Code (China site)
MiniMax Code official documentation and web version
MiniMax API platform: keys, Token Plan and pricing
MiniMax Code open-source repository, published by MiniMax
DeepSeek official website, including the DeepSeek Harness developer preview page
DeepSeek harness source repository, published by the deepseek-ai organisation; npm package @deepseek-ai/dsh
